name: The MeatHouse - Century Square
description:
Presenting an inventive menu of premium meats inspired by international cuisines, The Meathöuse is a halal steakhouse featuring a highly curated and original menu specially curated by renowned Eighteen Chefs cook, chef Benny Se Teo.

Housing a comprehensive range of Western delights, indulge in a bowl of steaming hot Cream of Mushroom soup. Peppered with trio mushrooms and drizzled with truffle oil, the harmonious combination of truffle and mushrooms will definitely have you hooked. Topped with minced beef and a generous amount of sweet and spicy chilli, the All Chilli Beef Fries is a great sharing option to add to family dinners and celebratory gatherings. Alternatively, truffle fans can opt for the classic French Fries with Truffle.

Ever heard of chocolate sauce as an optional topping for your burger? Here at The Meathöuse, you can choose to drench your Yin Yang Burger in a decadent glaze of delicious chocolate sauce.
